title: Failure Diagnosis Chooser
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: DGX Evaluation for Textbook Generation
description: Attribute each of eight failed-run symptoms to its most likely cause from a list of eight.

educational.topic: Diagnosing Failures, Reporting, and Cost per Textbook
learningObjectives: The learner will attribute each of 8 failed-run symptoms to its most likely cause from a list of 8, with at least 7 of 8 correct.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then see the correct answer and the reason
keyQuestions: Symptoms 1 and 6 both end a run with nothing done. State the detail in each that tells the two causes apart.
commonMisconceptions: A failure that ends a run is always a model failure.
A tool error means the run cannot recover.
A slow run is a failed run.
A model that says it is doing the work has done it.
assessmentOpportunities: Mastery is 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt.

chapter_title: Diagnosing Failures, Reporting, and Cost per Textbook
